content.title: Denny's (DENN): Profit Margin Falls to 2.2%, Testing Growth Optimism vs. Market Caution
content.summary: Denny's (DENN) reported that earnings have declined at an average annual rate of 11.9% over the past five years, with net profit margins tightening to 2.2% from 3.9% a year ago. Looking ahead, the company is projected to rebound strongly, with earnings expected to grow about 39.8% per year, significantly ahead of the broader US market's 16% forecast, while revenue growth is estimated at a slower 3.4% per year. content.title: Why Denny's Stock Rocketed 50% Higher Today
Denny's (DENN) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
content.summary: Shares of diner restaurant chain Denny’s (NASDAQ:DENN) jumped 49.8% in the morning session after the company announced it had agreed to be acquired by a group of investors in an all-cash deal that will take the diner chain private.

content.title: Why Are Kura Sushi (KRUS) Shares Soaring Today
content.summary: Shares of sushi restaurant chain Kura Sushi (NASDAQ:KRUS) jumped 5.5% in the morning session after its stock was lifted by positive sentiment in the restaurant sector after peer Denny's Corp. announced it had agreed to be acquired at a significant premium. The Denny's buyout deal was valued at $620 million, which represented a 52.1% premium to its closing price from the previous session. content.title: Apple reportedly eyes a budget laptop, Denny's to go private
content.description:
Some of the stories Wall Street is watching on Tuesday, Nov. 4, include:

Apple (AAPL) is preparing to launch a low-cost Mac laptop next year, according to a report from Bloomberg.

Papa John's (PZZA) shares are falling following a Reuters report that Apollo Global has pulled its offer to take the pizza chain private.

Shares of Denny's (DENN) are soaring after agreeing to go private.
